name: H-E-B eCommerce Fulfillment Center - Houston (Holmes Road) - Houston TX

fieldNotes.location: 4520 Holmes Rd, Houston TX 77033 - confirmed by web research and imagery. The roster ROOFTOP geocode (moved 940 m) resolved onto the correct building - a single recently-built fulfillment center wedged between Holmes Rd (W), a rail line (NW) and a freeway (S). The H-E-B red logo is visible on the building in 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The site has a fully-fenced perimeter (ornamental metal-mesh fence confirmed on the W, N and E sides in Street View) with a single wide driveway entrance off Holmes Rd on the W - a clear controlled entry pinch-point for a modern automated eFC.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth was positively identified at the entrance driveway in satellite or Street View; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present with no visible guard shack - implies kiosk / app / remote check-in, typical of a 2025-era automated eFC.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the fence (the wrap-around yard and the N circular turnaround) before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach wraps around the building with ample depth to hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the building's south face; ~7 doors with trailers/equipment visible plus the bank continuing - estimated ~12 doors, 10-25 band (could be lower); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 0-10 - only a small number of trailers staged in the yard; this is a 100,000 sq ft eFC, not a drop-yard operation.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the NW edge of the property but no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single stand-alone building - not a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense SE Houston near a major freeway interchange - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingDescription: 100,000 sq ft stand-alone e-commerce fulfillment center, opened Feb 2025, H-E-B's 3rd Houston eFC; Swisslog AutoStore + SynQ automation.

citations.claim: H-E-B opens 100,000 sq ft stand-alone eFC at 4520 Holmes Rd, Houston (3rd Houston eFC)
H-E-B opens another stand-alone e-commerce fulfillment center in Houston

verification.rationale: Stand-alone 100K sq ft eFC opened Feb 2025 with dedicated dock/yard; no negatives.
